t.zh: 两件事同真同假，叫，写作 ↔。
t.en: Two things true together and false together are in , written ↔.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「（若下雨，则地湿）并且（若地湿，则下雨）」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “(if it rains, the ground is wet) and (if the ground is wet, it rains)” on every row.

hint.zh: 这句话由哪几部分组成？
hint.en: What parts is the sentence made of?
